reason: I already have my fabric shop that knows me and I'm sewing a wedding outfit with a deadline next month, so this is not the time to gamble on a new seller I've never touched fabric from. 14.90 for black viscose is fine, but it's not low enough to make me switch.
objection: I can't feel the drape or see the true colour online, and if a stranger's cut arrives wrong or late I miss the wedding. Plus I'd bet I can find the same viscose cheaper on Allegro.
would_change_my_mind: If my usual shop ran out of what I need and they had it, or a cheap swatch I could check before the wedding.
